name: WiredNYC – Participating Buildings
description:
This dataset lists New York City commercial buildings that participate in the WiredNYC program, which rates buildings on their broadband and telecommunications infrastructure. Each row represents one building, with about 200 buildings sampled here. Columns cover three areas: location (borough, street address, building name, BBL and BIN identifiers, community board and council, census tract, NTA neighborhood, ZIP code, and latitude/longitude), connectivity (certification class such as Platinum, Gold, Silver, Connected, or Not certified; number of carriers and ISPs; availability of coax cable, fiber, and satellite/fixed wireless connections; fiber distribution across floors), and physical telecom provisions (riser space for current and additional providers, diverse riser locations, multiple points of entry, designated telecom utility space, signed points of entry, and agreements). Most buildings are in Manhattan, and many are not certified. Some fields, such as the named ISP list and coordinates, have missing values.
